scene: You step off the ferris wheel gondola into bustling Midnight Carnival.
picture: A flat side view of a carnival promenade under night sky. Far left sits the open ferris wheel gondola. The tall Latino man stands left of centre in his teal bomber jacket and jeans. On the left stands a glowing fortune booth, in the centre spins a carousel, and on the right stands a striped tent.
shown: a glowing robotic fortune teller booth sitting silently on the left
an ornate carousel spinning slowly with vacant brass saddles at the centre
a purple-striped canvas tent with a parted curtain door on the right

variants.scene: Strings of warm fairground bulbs glow across the lively evening carnival grounds.
You arrive under the starry sky, still humming {tune} above the carnival chatter.
The festive fairgrounds bustle with visitors beneath the spinning, illuminated attractions.
